subject: maths
question: Vimala took a loan of Rs. 7,200 on simple interest for as many years as the rate of interest. If she paid Rs. 5,832 as interest at the end of the loan period, then the rate of interest is:
solution:
Formula:

SI = (P x R x T) / 100

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time

Calculation :

Let the time and rate of interest be t.

According to the question,

⇒ 5,832 = (7,200 x t x t) / 100 

⇒ t² = 5,832 / 72

⇒ t = 9 

∴ The rate of interest is 9%.
